digest.component_or_area: test harness - source-scan and build-provenance contracts
propositions: test_shipped_surfaces_name_no_retired_bridge_command fails when scanning src/rebar recursively encounters non-UTF-8 binaries like Mach-O esbuild in ignored editor_assets/node_modules
test_hook_falls_back_to_git_when_env_unset fails when cloning the current checkout if it is a shallow promisor clone with unavailable historical objects
shipped-surface test must enumerate only tracked/package-shipped textual inputs via git ls-files and match tokens as bytes to tolerate ignored binaries while still catching stale command tokens
build-provenance test must not depend on cloning the full source object database and should construct a self-contained minimal git fixture with materialized required objects
both tests must remain behavioral oracles: stale shipped tokens must fail and git-fallback provenance must prove the wheel embeds the correct commit sha
